card.name: Start of 'inhal-' and 'unacceptable' words
card.fires_on: Partway through certain words: the 'Inhal' start of inhalation/inhalational, and 'unacceptable' in 'until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity'. Also seen on a few odd word starts like 'aliqu' and 'sluggish'.

modes.label: Inhal- words
modes.description: The start of inhalation or inhalational in product names and headings.
modes.example: 500 mg to maximum dose of 750 mg<< Inhal>>ational Anthrax (Post-Exposure

modes.label: Unacceptable toxicity
modes.description: The word 'unacceptable' after 'progression or' in treatment-duration phrases.
modes.example: parza treatment until disease progression,<< unacceptable>> toxicity, or completion of 2 years

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: The first part of a split word such as aliquot or an author surname in a reference list.

card.plain: It fires on a few specific word starts, mainly 'inhal-' and 'unacceptable' before toxicity.
